issues: Hidden or collapsed menu items (e.g., 'Leje', 'Legalizime', 'Inspektoriati ndërtimor') are focusable in the tab sequence before the main 'MENU' button (item 7) is activated. This makes the focus order illogical and unpredictable for keyboard users, as they tab through many invisible elements.

An empty DIV (item 5) and an empty BUTTON (item 8) receive focus without providing any discernible name or purpose. This is confusing for keyboard and screen reader users, violating the principle of predictable focus order and operability.
items.suggestion: Ensure that elements that are not visually displayed (e.g., collapsed menu items) are not focusable until they are made visible and interactive. This can be achieved by setting `tabindex='-1'` on hidden elements and removing it when they become visible, or by using CSS properties like `display: none` or `visibility: hidden`. Additionally, all interactive elements must have a meaningful, accessible name; the empty DIV and BUTTON should either be given appropriate labels/content or removed from the tab order if they are not intended to be interactive.
